The '''Hinakuu system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hinakuu]], and was connected to the [[Sanctuary system|Sanctuary]] and [[Krinemonen system/Legends|Krinemonen]] systems by the [[Tidal Circuit]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]].

The system was colonized by the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] between [[4400 BBY|4400]] and [[4200 BBY]] after [[Q-Viza]] invented the [[cavitation hyperdrive]].
